jobs.occupation: Finance Business Partner
jobs.description:
**Finance Business Partner, VELUX A/S - Østbirk

****Do you enjoy turning data into meaningful insights and working closely with people to influence decisions and drive performance? With a passion for business partnering and a strong analytical mindset, you could be our next Finance Business Partner in Østbirk.

****Meet your future team

**As part of our Global Finance team, you will join a group of dedicated and experienced colleagues supporting our production sites in Østbirk and Brædstrup. Together, we work to bring financial insights to life and enable informed business decisions that create value across the organisation.

In this role, you will work closely with operational leaders, managers, and finance stakeholders, building trusted relationships and gaining a deep understanding of our manufacturing business. We value collaboration, knowledge sharing, openness, and continuous learning, creating an environment where everyone can contribute and develop their skills.

**What We Offer

**As Finance Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting business performance and helping operational teams make data-driven decisions. You will have the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment where your expertise and insights contribute directly to business success.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Partner with managers and operational teams to provide financial insights and decision support.

• Monitor and analyse efficiency, production performance, material consumption, budgets, and key operational KPIs.

• Prepare financial analyses, business cases, and presentations to support strategic and operational decision-making.

• Support budgeting, forecasting, and monthly reporting processes.

• Contribute to standard costing and product costing activities within a manufacturing environment.

• Develop and enhance reports and dashboards using Excel and Power BI.

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, efficiencies, and value creation.

• Communicate financial information clearly and effectively to stakeholders across different functions and levels.

**What You Will Bring

**We are looking for a collaborative and curious finance professional who enjoys combining analytical thinking with strong business understanding. Whether your background is in Finance Business Partnering, Controlling, Financial Analysis, or a related field, you are motivated by creating value through insights and strong stakeholder relationships.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.

• Have strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into meaningful business insights.

• Build positive and productive relationships with stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• Have advanced Excel capabilities and an interest in reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI.

• Communicate fluently in both Danish and English.

• Work in a structured and organised manner while remaining flexible and solution-oriented.

• Thrive in a collaborative environment where teamwork and knowledge sharing are highly valued.

• Bring experience with SAP, standard costing, or product costing, although this is considered an advantage rather than a requirement.

If you do not meet every requirement but believe your experience and potential make you a strong candidate, we encourage you to apply. We recognise that diverse experiences and perspectives strengthen our teams and contribute to better outcomes.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof to transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees, and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

jobs.occupation: Customs & Trade Compliance Professional, Assens, DK / Global Customs & Trade Compliance
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by ensuring full compliance in a complex and fast-evolving regulatory landscape? As our new Customs & Trade Compliance Professional, you'll play a key role in safeguarding STG's global trade flows and reducing customs-related risk. You'll work closely with Planning, Customs & Transportation, Procurement, and Finance to keep customs processes compliant, efficient, and well-documented.

What your day will look like

• Manage and follow up on import and export procedures to ensure compliant, timely customs flows

• Monitor and implement customs legislation changes and country-specific obligations

• Set up and oversee customs regimes such as EMCS (Excise Movement and Control System), IPR (Inward Processing Relief), and bonded warehouse processes

• Classify products and determine valuation and origin (HS – Harmonized System, ECS – Export Control System, FTA – Free Trade Agreement) for accurate declarations and duty management

• Support SAP-based customs processes as a basic user (training provided)

• Conduct regular risk assessments and manage customs claims, with proactive mitigation and clear documentation

Keystakeholders

Material Planning · Customs & Transportation · Procurement · Finance · Manufacturing · Tax/Legal · IT/Reporting · SST · Warehousing

What you'll bring

• Proven experience in customs & trade compliance, including hands-on work with import/export processes and customs regimes

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in declarations and documentation

• Analytical ability to interpret and apply legislation

• Proactive, service-oriented mindset with strong stakeholder collaboration skills

• Danish language proficiency and valid Danish ID Card

• Working proficiency in English

Nice-to-have: Descartes software experience

• Advantage: experience with AEO (Authorised Economic Operator), UCC (Union Customs Code), CBAM (Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism), EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation), or customs audits

Working at STG & What to expect

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.  At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact.

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 432,000–648,000 annually corresponding to the level of the position, expected experience and responsibilities.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Our recruitment process

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you’ll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:.

• Recruiter screening

• First round: interview with the Hiring Manager - 1 hour, technical depth

• PI assessment

• Second round: interview with a Senior Stakeholder – 30–45 min

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs.

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Senior Consultant, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups — locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

We are looking for highly motivated and ambitious Senior Consultant who can contribute across a broad spectrum of projects — including implementation, optimization, and ongoing consulting for the commercial area (SFE,CRM). The role is open to candidates with either a technical background or a business consulting mindset, as long as you bring curiosity, structure, and a collaborative spirit.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, helping clients translate business goals into scalable, system-supported solutions.

Your responsibilities include:

• Lead workstreams or small teams on client projects, ensuring high-quality delivery and stakeholder alignment.

• Conduct process assessments and define future-state operating models across commercial functions.

• Translate business needs into system requirements and support end-to-end implementation of platforms.

• Facilitate workshops, gather requirements, and manage documentation (e.g., project plans, RAID logs).

• Support IT and commercial strategy definition, including CRM optimization and system integration.

• Drive change management activities, including training design, stakeholder engagement, and adoption planning.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, bringing structure, insight, and industry best practices.

• Engage in Sales processes by taking part in RfP responses and delivering presentations.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience ideally in project-based roles within consulting or the life sciences sector implementing solutions for the commercial area.

• Required consulting and hands-on experience in Salesforce, Veeva, and other CRM systems (certifications in Salesforce and Veeva will be a plus). Technical understanding is a plus, especially for projects involving IT collaboration.

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Strong communication skills, both verbal and written in English.

• Ability to create compelling presentations and confidently present to diverse audiences.

• Proactive mindset with a “can-do” attitude and eagerness to learn.

• Comfortable working in agile teams and remote environments.

• Project Management and Agile methodologies experience (certifications on Agile, PMP... will be a plus).

• Experience facilitating workshops and driving client expectations into sustainable solutions.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage change at scale.

• It will be a plus if you have these additional capabilities:

• Experience working in global or regulated industries (e.g., pharma, finance).

• Prior consulting experience — especially in top-tier consulting firms — is valued but not required.

• Exposure to enterprise platform rollouts or system integration projects.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.

• Experience contributing to Salesforce Effectiveness initiatives, including CRM usage optimization, sales process alignment, and support for user adoption strategies.

• Interest in emerging technologies and AI.

This position is offered in Denmark.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

• Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning

• Execution matters — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice

• Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines

• Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

jobs.occupation: Data Science & BI Developer
jobs.description:
Be a part of the data revolution in sports!

This is a great opportunity to join our growing Data Science and BI developer team. Our team is responsible for the development and operations of both our internal and customer-facing reporting and dashboard solutions, as well as our data science and machine learning products. We are focused on making our rich tracking data more actionable to customers as well as supporting our internal product development and operations with useful insights. We also use our data to develop data science and machine learning solutions that enhance our product experiences. In collaboration with our cutting-edge radar and computer vision-based tracking technology, we are building products used by the best athletes in the world.

Example projects we are working on:

• Reporting for environmental variations between stadium tracking locations based on athlete performance models and statistical analysis

• Dashboards for trends and detecting outliers in radar tracking and computer vision diagnostics across thousands of remote devices

• Translating ball tracking metrics into coaching-orientated measures to help amateur athletes improve their performance

• Supervised learning models to suggest both practice and gameplay recommendations to make our sophisticated products easier to use

• Vision-based person detection combined with predicting the position they play on the field for game strategy

Your Profile

You have hands-on experience working with data day to day in SQL and python, from the fundamentals of loading, ETL, and pipeline automation to answering ad-hoc questions from the business and operations teams. You have experience developing reports and dashboards to address the questions that are reoccurring. You are familiar with using a developer tool stack and operating in a scrum team. You also have experience using data science modelling techniques to derive next-level insight from data, as well as an appreciation for running machine learning in production. Your focus is on the practical outcome and value to the business of using data to inform everything we do. You like working in an international team across many cultures. You like sports.

Responsibilities

• Develop internal and customer-facing BI reports and dashboards

• Use dimensional modelling to develop database schemas and semantic layers

• Manage data warehouse data pipeline automation rules, ensure smooth operations

• Work with our Data Engineers to acquire and prepare working data, initial data cleaning, statistical analysis, and mining

• Interface with product owners, operations, and developers to refine requirements

• Identify and perform data science model selection, feature engineering, and tuning, develop an experiment based and evaluation workflow, package for production

Job requirements

• A strong educational background where coursework required heavy use of data and a scientific or engineering based workflows

• Experience with data processing, preparation, cleansing, and mining, in SQL and Python

• Experience developing dashboards and reports in a BI toolset

• Experience with applying data science and machine learning methods and move across a variety of unsupervised and supervised approaches, experience with NumPy, pandas, sci-kit learn

Working in a fast-paced, team-based environment also demands a certain degree of self-planning, as well as the ability to work independently. Your colleagues are highly skilled, innovative, and proactive in their work approach. They possess strong analytical skills, are good communicators in English, and take pride in their job and deliverables.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency
jobs.employer_name: Center for Kvantitativ Genetik og Genomforskning
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Quantitative Genetics and Genomics programme. The position is available from 1 March 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency

Research area and project description
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) holds a leading position in cattle breeding research, particularly in genetic studies on data generated by advanced phenotyping technologies such as the CFIT 3D camera system through industry collaboration with VikingGenetics. This state-of-the-art system enables large-scale, non-invasive measurement of feed intake, body weight, and milk production data in over 30,000 cows directly in their production environment. This PhD project will leverage this extensive phenotypic dataset generated by CFIT, in combination with feeding parameters and other phenotypes from the Danish Cattle Database, to develop genetic tools aimed at enhancing nitrogen efficiency, resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The goal is to develop novel genomic breeding values for nitrogen efficiency, while considering other important breeding goal traits (e.g., productivity, health, fertility) and other traits, such as resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The project will apply advanced statistical methods, artificial intelligence, and cutting-edge genetic models to support and enhance management and breeding decision-making by dairy farmers. This project offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the green transition in agriculture by breeding cows that are both more sustainable and economically viable for the future of Danish dairy farming. We encourage candidates finishing their MSc in summer 2027 also to apply.

Qualifications and specific competences
A relevant master’s degree (120 ECTS) in Animal Breeding
Experience with data handling softwares (e.g., R, SAS, Python, Unix Shell) and genetic softwares (e.g., DMU, BLUPF90, AIREML).
Background in working with Livestock data is an advantage.
The ability to speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite for the applicant.
Can speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics, C.F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Bingjie Li, e-mail: bingjie.li@qgg.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Tenure Track Assistant Professor Rasmus Bak Stephansen, e-mail: rasmus.stephansen@qgg.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 29 November 2026 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 March 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

Our customers are classified and cannot be disclosed, so your work will take place in secure environments, often in collaboration with Product teams, security teams and onsite at customer locations. As this is a newly established position, you will have the opportunity to help shape this role as it grows.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Training, evaluating and refining machine learning models on customer data

• Integrating models and data-driven features that generate measurable value

• Exploring customer data to identify new opportunities for value creation

• Collaborating with security teams to ensure compliance with national classifications and profiles

Joining the team

You will join an organisation where you will be associated with multiple teams, part of our NSI business unit. We develop and maintain military-grade solutions that support a nation's most critical systems. The organisation is highly collaborative, organised around Products that make a difference.

If you are located in Aarhus, we are open to discussing a hybrid arrangement, but you should expect regular presence in Copenhagen (6–8 days per month).

Your qualifications

We are looking for a data scientist with hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world data in production settings, who can work confidently in high-stakes, security-classified environments.

• Relevant technical education, Bachelor's or Master's, in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or equivalent experience

• Documented experience with applied machine learning on real-world data

• Some hands-on experience with data science and machine learning in production settings

• Strong knowledge of Python, machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow), SQL and data processing tools

• Fluent Danish and English skills

• A strong security mindset and ability to work in high-stakes environments

Alongside this, we value:

• A collaborative and proactive work style

• Comfortable working independently and navigating ambiguity, particularly as this is a newly established role
